notes:
RunState is a devtools startup building an IDE-first copilot that can execute developer workflows (unit tests, linters, build steps) via function-calls to sandboxed runners. Notes from calls:
- "We want the assistant to actually run tests, not just suggest commands." (CEO)
- They require ephemeral containers with strict egress rules, no external network by default, and file-system mount controls.
- Interested in model/version pinning: want to freeze a specific model for CI runs and have a fallback light model for low-cost reruns.
- Primary ask: function-calling hooks for three agent actions: run-tests (accepts test selection, env matrix), run-lint (ruleset, autofix option), stream-build-log (live log streaming + truncation policy).
- PII/data handling: test artifacts may contain secrets in env vars; need integrated KMS + audit logs for any artifact retention.
- Latency targets: interactive code-completion streaming <50ms token latency; test-run commands can be async but want start-of-run acknowledgement <200ms.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; willing to commit to Dedicated if POC shows predictable cost per run.
- Quote from lead engineer: "We need deterministic runtimes for flaky tests — replayability + pinned model + deterministic RNG important."
- They asked about Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching user sessions vs CI bursts.
- Suggested next: provide a POC template with function schema examples and sandbox attestation sample.
use_case_summary: Integrate Redwood inference into an in-IDE copilot that can call sandboxed functions to run tests, linters, and stream build logs. Require low token latency for completions, model pinning for deterministic CI runs, and private deployment with strict network and audit controls.
requirements: Function-calling primitives with typed payloads for run-tests/run-lint/stream-build-log
Ephemeral sandbox orchestration (container + seccomp + chroot) with attestation tokens
VPC/private control plane option for PII and secret handling
Model pinning + rollout controls (canary to fallback model)
Streaming with per-token latency <50ms for editor completions
Start-of-run acknowledgement <200ms; webhook/callback when executions finish
Audit logging and retention controls for build artifacts
KMS integration for secrets passed to ephemeral runners
Policy hooks for disallowing outbound network from sandboxes
